Short lead notes: inbound SMB looking for hosted API (self-serve -> low-friction). Main asks: SOC2 Type II report, canonical sub-processors list, DPA/DPA template, simple retention controls. Quoted from call: "We need to show vendor risk team the SOC2 and we need a clear sub-processor list — especially around EU data handling."

Technical / product: planning embeddings-first pilot (semantic search over KB), then in-chat suggestion slots. Latency target: chat suggestions p95 under 300ms; embeddings batch throughput modest (will start with 10 qps, aim 50). Cost sensitivity: moderate — looking for predictable per-embedding pricing; wants guidance on batching + caching to reduce cost.

Security specifics captured in questionnaire: encryption at rest (KMS), encryption in transit, access controls (RBAC + token scoping), audit logs, data retention policy (prefer 30d ephemeral storage for request logs), sub-processor list (must include cloud infra, monitoring, analytics vendors), SOC2 Type II (or roadmap to obtain one). Also ask about DPA with EU data residency clause — they'll push for data residency if pilot expands to EU customers.
